evidence.quote: May the agent pay without asking again: yes

purchaseAuthorized.note: The buyer allowed the agent to pay without asking again.

itemMatchesMandate.note: The mandate asks for the 20-inch model (Item: Norvik AirLite carry-on suitcase, 20-inch), but the 24-inch model was ordered.

quantityMatchesMandate.note: One unit was ordered and the mandate asks for one.

withinSpendingLimit.note: The total of $92.95 is within the $100.00 limit.

storeChargedAsOrdered.note: The store charged the cart the agent submitted.

storeFulfilledAsOrdered.note: The store shipped the item that the order contains.

verdict.reason: The agent paid for a 24-inch suitcase with oversize shipping, but the mandate approved only the 20-inch Norvik AirLite. The order therefore differs from the approved item. The store charged and shipped what was ordered, so the store is not responsible, and the buyer did not approve this order, so the buyer is not responsible.
